edges.reason: msg.sender is used for the bots[msg.sender] check and Uniswap-caller restriction inside _transfer
openTrading is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _devFund
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _devFund
setBots is restricted by onlyOwner
delBot is restricted by onlyOwner
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner
setMaxTxPercent is restricted by onlyOwner
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction
cooldown[to] is compared and written using block.timestamp
swap deadline argument is block.timestamp
addLiquidityETH deadline argument is block.timestamp
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard after toggling fees
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team share
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection share
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute r/t amounts
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the contract balance before finishing accounting
_transfer forwards contract ETH to fee receivers during the transfer
_transfer writes cooldown[to] from block.timestamp on pair buys
_transfer blacklists accounts when block.number <= launchBlock + 2 and amount == _maxTxAmount
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call that can re-enter via the pair
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to EOAs, an external call before accounting completes
openTrading calls the factory createPair external function
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance
manualswap triggers the swap routine on the full contract token balance
manualsend triggers ETH distribution to fee receivers
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances
transferFrom reads and updates _allowances
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal using SafeMath subtraction
_taxFee feeds _getTValues inside _getValues
_teamFee feeds _getTValues inside _getValues
bots mapping gates transfers for from, to and msg.sender
cooldown mapping is read to enforce buy cooldown
_devFund receives half of the distributed ETH
_marketingFunds receives half of the distributed ETH
uniswapV2Router is used for the swap and WETH lookup
uniswapV2Pair address is compared against from/to
inSwap guard (lockTheSwap) prevents nested swap execution
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown and caller restrictions
_maxTxAmount is compared with the transfer amount for bot detection
launchBlock defines the early-trading bot detection window
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether fees are taken
from address parameter drives sender-side balance and bot logic
to address parameter drives recipient-side balance and bot logic
amount parameter is checked against _maxTxAmount and zero
maxTxPercent parameter updates _maxTxAmount state variable
bots_ array entries are written into the bots blacklist
contractTokenBalance local is passed as the swap amount
contractETHBalance local is passed to sendETHToFee
path local [token, WETH] is supplied to the router swap
